description: Of 656 interpretable answers from 724 online adults, 34 (5.1%) expressed some belief that vision involves something leaving the eye, far below earlier reports of more than half of US college students.
limitations: Online sample, and the wording may have primed scientific answers. The authors cannot explain the gap from earlier studies.

sources.quote: Thus, 34/656 (5.1%) expressed a belief in some form of extramission.
